description: A color palette that displays predefined colors in a grid. Users can click a swatch to select a color. The grid is a labelled radiogroup and every swatch is a native button with role=radio, its own accessible name (from ColorNames, or the color value) and aria-checked for the selection; the roving tabindex moves with the arrows and Home/End. Arrow keys move focus only (selection does not follow focus) so embedded pickers do not commit on navigation; Enter/Space select. The two-tone focus ring runs inside the swatch edge, independent of neighbouring swatches, and a forced-colors variant keeps the swatch colors and marks the selection with the system highlight color.

parameters.name: Colors
parameters.description: Predefined colors to display. Defaults to a standard palette.

parameters.name: ColorNames
parameters.description: Accessible names for the colors, keyed by the color string as it appears in Colors (matched case-insensitively; a key spelled exactly like the palette color wins over a case-variant duplicate). A named swatch announces the localized 'Select color {0}' template with its name; an unnamed — or blank-named — color falls back to announcing its raw value, so a screen reader can always tell the swatches apart. Custom ITmLocalizer implementations without the SelectColorNamed template fall back to the plain Select color text plus the name/value.

parameters.name: Columns
parameters.description: Number of columns in the grid. Default 8.

parameters.name: ShowClearButton
parameters.description: Shows a clear button. Default true.

parameters.name: ValueChanged
parameters.description: Event fired when a color is selected.
